content: Cal.com API v2 exposes /slots/available?eventTypeId&startTime&endTime returning available slot lists; resources are organized as event-types, availability(schedules), slots, bookings. Calendly exposes availability/busy-times per user/event-type, treating externally synced calendar events marked Busy as conflicts and Free as ignored. Both model availability as a queryable derived view (slots or free/busy windows) computed from schedule + existing bookings, not stored directly.
